---
title: "About"
---

I am a professor at the Graduate School of Innovation Management, Hosei University (Tokyo). I teach business data analysis, research methodology, and marketing science in the MBA program. My research covers qualitative comparative analysis (QCA), marketing science, brand management, and statistics.

## What you will find here

- Notes on threshold-sweep QCA and the ThSQCA R package
- Reproducible R code for QCA and marketing research
- Small browser-based tools for data analysis
